title: A COMMITTED approval is visible on the plan surface (t3's F1)

finding.measuredBy: t3 on the REAL tmux TUI — evidence/tui/team-surface-verify/2026-09-16T14-16-27.925Z/panes/approve-attempt.pane.txt (the pre-fix pane shows only `MPD plan approval — no staged plan for team mpd-fixture-1 (phase running)` + `esc back`)
finding.rootCause: runApprove sets `approved: <id> running · members <n> · tasks <n>`, then its `finally` re-reads the record. The adopted tool has flipped phase staged -> running, so `usable` is false and the ENTIRE action block — the only place that message renders — is dropped.

fix.shape: ONE branch added to the plan scene's non-usable path, no barrier weakened and no new mutation path. `message` is the last SETTLED outcome of a call started while the plan was actionable (`approved: …` / `discarded: …` / a tool refusal / `working…`). When it is non-empty the surface now renders, in order: a neutral title `MPD plan approval — <team name>`, the verdict row itself (bold, byte-identical to the frozen §4.5 row 1 string), a dim `team <id> · phase <phase>` context row, and `esc back`. When it is EMPTY the precondition-failure rendering is byte-identical to before (title + `no staged plan for team …` + `esc back`) — which is exactly what the lane's malformed/non-staged/absent arms assert.
fix.whyNotTheEchoOrTheGate: The verdict is a DISPLAY of an outcome that already happened; it touches neither the confirmation phrase, the echo lifecycle (§4.5 still keeps the echo on a refusal), the chords, single-flight nor the precondition gate (the non-usable branch still ignores every key except Esc).

acceptance.criterion: after a SUCCESSFUL approval the plan surface renders a verdict line naming what happened (team id + resulting phase + the member/task counts), never the bare empty state
acceptance.evidence: REAL HOST (the same lane t3 used): evidence/tui/team-surface-verify/2026-09-16T14-22-36.219Z — arm2 H4 `pane outcome: approved-by-the-adopted-runtime/verdict-visible`, H4b `verdict line "approved: mpd-fixture-1 running · members 2 · tasks 2", post-commit empty state false`, H5 pane-and-record agree, and `findings: []` (the finding this repair closes). IN-PROCESS: test/team-surface.test.ts `t8 — the verdict renders even though the record has LEFT the staged phase` drives the real component with an executor that rewrites team.json (phase -> running, approvedAt set, planReviewState deleted), then asserts the verdict row is the FIRST body row, that `no staged plan for team mpd-fixture-1` is absent, and that the verdict survives a re-render.

acceptance.criterion: the refusal path is untouched: a refused/mismatched confirmation still keeps the echo and shows 'confirmation does not match this team' (t6's F3 behaviour stays intact)
acceptance.evidence: t6's tests still pass unchanged: `§4.5 — a refused approve KEEPS the echo` and `a successful approve CONSUMES the echo` are green in the 45-test suite, and the lane's arm1 B1/B2/B3 (empty echo / wrong id / cancelled) each still fail the approval assertion and each render `confirmation does not match this team`. New coverage for the one interaction this repair could have disturbed: `a REFUSED call in the non-usable branch reports the refusal, never a success` (the plan approved elsewhere -> the tool refuses -> the surface shows the refusal, not a success).

acceptance.criterion: a NEGATIVE CONTROL reddens on the new assertion only; report the red count before/after
acceptance.evidence: evidence/tui/team-surface-verify/2026-09-16T14-21-34.913Z/negative-control/result.json — mutation `T8-remove-the-verdict-render` (`if (verdict) {` -> `if (false) {`): RED COUNT BEFORE = 0, AFTER = 2, and the two red tests are exactly the new ones: `t8 … > the verdict renders even though the record has LEFT the staged phase` and `t8 … > a REFUSED call in the non-usable branch reports the refusal, never a success`. `unrelatedTestsReddened: []`, source restored byte-identical (sha256), restored suite green.
